notes: The italic even stands before an appositive no marker marks, so it is added rather than any marker's (rule 16's limit).
The articleless participle פֹרְשִׂים keeps the supplied relative with itself under rule 41; the לְ standing before it is left with no English by that recasting (rule 40).
their wings is one added run of supplied English: no object morpheme stands in the clause and no suffix licenses the possessive (rules 2, 18, 44).
